subject: Admin activity evidence: live export options and attestations for SIG+SOC2
messages:
From: Elaine Moore <elaine@bluehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: admin activity evidence for SIG / SOC 2 — export & attestations

Hi Rishi,

We're finalizing the SIG and SOC 2 evidence bundle for our March review and need a clear answer on Redwood's admin activity logging. Specifically: 
- What admin/operator events are logged (examples: role changes, API key usage, CLI actions, model access, keystore/HSM ops)?
- Retention windows for live logs vs. snapshots/archived bundles.
- Export formats and delivery options (S3 signed bundle, SFTP push, on-demand API, streaming/pubsub).
- Support for signed manifests (HMAC/SHA256) and chain-of-custody assertions.
- Any redaction/sampling options you offer for PII-sensitive fields.

Can you provide an example manifest and a short runbook for how we'd request an on-demand extract (90-day window) and what the lead time is? Also include costs or quotes if there are per-export fees.

Thanks — we need this for our compliance owners by EOD 16 Mar.

Best,
Elaine Moore
Security Ops, BlueHealth


From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Moore <elaine@bluehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity evidence for SIG / SOC 2 — export & attestations

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear list. High-level answers below and attached is a starter SIG worksheet mapping (SIG_admin_activity_response.xlsx) plus an export playbook (export_playbook_v2.pdf).

What we log (examples):
- Privileged user actions: role & permission changes, invitation/SSO provisioning, password reset flows.
- Operator/infrastructure actions: deployment rollouts, config changes, cluster node reboots, autoscale events.
- API/CLI calls: create/update/delete model endpoints, model version pinning, inference request metadata when marked for audit.
- Access to sensitive artifacts: secrets/KMS/HSM key rotations, KMS encrypt/decrypt calls metadata (not raw keys), model artifact pull/push events.
- Session & auth events: successful/failed logins, SSO assertions, token issuance/revocation, refresh events.
- KV cache and admin cache invalidation events (timestamped).

Retention & snapshot policy (default):
- Live retention: 90 days of full-fidelity admin activity (timestamped, actor, action, object, request_id, ip).
- Archive snapshots: 12-month snapshot retention available for enterprise plans (scheduled daily snapshots, gzipped NDJSON).
- Long-term: we can configure annual snapshots retained offsite for up to 5 years under dedicated contracts (required for regulated customers).

Export/delivery options:
- On-demand bundle: gzipped NDJSON or Parquet, HMAC-SHA256-signed manifest, delivered via:
  * S3 presigned PUT to your bucket,
  * Push to your SFTP endpoint (SFTP over SSH with server key pinning),
  * Secure Google Drive folder (for agreed legal buckets),
  * Encrypted HTTPS download link (short TTL).
- Streaming export (near-real-time): optional pub/sub/stream to customer endpoint (Kafka or Pub/Sub) with AES-256 encryption in transit and per-message sequence numbers — suitable for live monitoring teams.
- API access: paginated admin-activity API for programmatic on-demand pulls (rate-limited; export package recommended for larger windows).

Attestation & integrity:
- We provide a signed manifest (HMAC-SHA256) with each bundle and an accompanying attestation statement from our security team (time window, checksums, record counts).
- Chain-of-custody: signed manifest, SHA256 checksums per shard, and a delivery transfer log (SFTP logs / S3 put receipts).

Redaction & sampling:
- Field-level redaction: we can redact or truncate fields (email, username, raw request bodies) prior to export; redaction is deterministic and documented in the manifest.
- Sampling: support for deterministic sampling (e.g., 1-in-N or per-user stratified sampling) for very large datasets.

Lead time & costs:
- Standard on-demand export (<=90 days, single bundle) — 48–72 business hours SLA.
- SFTP push or presigned S3 — included for enterprise; ad-hoc exports for self-serve tenants may incur a one-time export fee.
- Streaming export onboarding — ~2–3 weeks (security review + endpoint testing).

Next steps:
1) Confirm the preferred delivery method (S3 vs SFTP vs Drive) and the desired window (e.g., last 90 days).
2) Indicate whether you require field-level redaction or full fidelity.
3) We can run a sample extract (signed manifest included) — suggested: 7-day sample within 48 hours.

I've cc'd Marissa (sales) and Kim (compliance) to help with pricing/contract items. If that works, I'll queue a sample run and send the export quote (export_quote_4832.pdf).

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Moore <elaine@bluehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueHealth Security Team <security@bluehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity evidence for SIG / SOC 2 — export & attestations

Rishi — thanks, that's very helpful. A few follow-ups: 
- We need signed manifests HMAC-SHA256 + per-shard SHA256 checksums. Confirmed — please include templates/examples.
- We require transfer into our SFTP host (sftp://exports.bluehealth.sftp.example.com) with host key pinning; can you provide host-key verification details?
- Can you confirm that KMS/HSM rotations are logged (we need timestamp + operator id + operation type) — you referenced KMS metadata but want explicit confirmation.

Also — any incremental costs for a one-off 12-month snapshot for our compliance team? If you can attach a PDF quote that breaks out the export fee and the snapshot retention add-on that will speed approval.

We'll take full-fidelity (no redaction) for the sample 7-day run; for the 12-month bundle we may request field-level redaction.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — needed by EOD 16 Mar.

Best,
Elaine

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Elaine — final checklist and immediate next steps per your ask (summary for compliance owners):

Planned deliverables:
- 7-day sample extract (full-fidelity NDJSON) — includes signed manifest (HMAC-SHA256), per-shard SHA256 checksums, and delivery receipt. ETA: 48 hours after we receive confirmation to proceed.
- 12-month archived snapshot (gzipped Parquet) — delivered to your SFTP with host key pinning + signed manifest. ETA: 5 business days after signed addendum and PO.

Data elements included in both bundles (explicit): timestamp, actor_id, actor_role, action_type, object_type, object_id, request_id, ip_address (redaction optional for long-term bundle), response_code, cluster_node_id, kms_key_id (not key material), operation_detail (truncated when necessary). KMS/HSM rotations: logged with timestamp + operator_id + rotation_type + resulting key metadata (uuid).

Integrity & chain-of-custody:
- Manifest fields: export_id, time_window, total_records, shard_count, per_shard_sha256, manifest_hmac_sha256, signer=rishi@redwood.com.
- Delivery log: SFTP transfer log + MD5 receipts where available, all stored in our evidence ledger.

Security & transfer notes:
- We will request your SFTP host public key fingerprint via separate secure channel (we do not accept fingerprints via email).
- All exports encrypted at rest; transit uses SSH/S3 HTTPS with TLS1.2+.

Attachments included with this thread: SIG_admin_activity_response.xlsx (mapping to SIG control IDs), export_playbook_v2.pdf (runbook + manifest examples), export_quote_4832.pdf (pricing), signed_manifest_example.txt (example manifest).

If you confirm SFTP as the destination and authorize the 7-day sample, we'll schedule the extract and share the signed manifest as the first deliverable.

Thanks — Rishi
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
